/* Unified API Styles */
.unified-api-container span[data-as=p] {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 1.25em;
  margin-bottom: 1.25em;
}

.unified-api-inline-label {
  padding: 2px 8px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  background-color: #F1EFF580;
  color: #111827;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-family: var(--font-jetbrains-mono), ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", "Courier New", monospace;
}

.unified-api-selector-container {
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}

.unified-api-description {
  padding: 6px 8px;
  font-size: 15px;
  color: #4f4e4a;
  border-radius: 6px;
  border-left: 4px solid #fafafa;
  background-color: #fdfdfd;
}

.unified-api-selector-label {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 36px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: #374151;
  line-height: 1.25;
}

.unified-api-selector-wrapper {
  position: relative;
  max-width: 300px;
}

.unified-api-selector-button {
  height: 40px;
  width: 100%;
  border-radius: 6px;
  border: 1px solid #d1d5db;
  background-color: #ffffff;
  padding: 0 32px 0 12px;
  font-size: 14px;
  color: #374151;
  outline: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  text-align: left;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  transition: border-color 0.2s ease-in-out, box-shadow 0.2s ease-in-out;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
  font-family: var(--font-jetbrains-mono), ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", "Courier New", monospace;
}

.unified-api-selector-button:hover {
  border-color: #9ca3af;
}

.unified-api-selector-button:focus {
  border-color: #3b82f6;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.1);
}

.unified-api-selector-arrow {
  transition: transform 0.2s ease-in-out;
}

.unified-api-selector-arrow.open {
  transform: rotate(180deg);
}

.unified-api-selector-dropdown {
  position: absolute;
  top: 100%;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  z-index: 50;
  margin-top: 4px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  border: 1px solid #d1d5db;
  background-color: #ffffff;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 25px -3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2), 0 4px 10px -2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
  max-height: 275px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.unified-api-selector-dropdown::after {
  content: '';
  position: sticky;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  height: 12px;
  background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(255, 255, 255, 1) 0%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5) 50%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3) 100%);
  z-index: 10;
  pointer-events: none;
  display: block;
  margin-top: -12px;
}


.unified-api-selector-option {
  padding: 10px 12px;
  font-size: 14px;
  color: #374151;
  cursor: pointer;
  background-color: #ffffff;
}

.unified-api-selector-option:not(:last-child) {
  margin-top: 1px;
  margin-bottom: 1px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #f5f5f5;
}

.unified-api-selector-option.selected {
  background-color: #f3f4f6;
}

.unified-api-selector-option:hover:not(.selected) {
  background-color: #f8fafc;
}

  margin-bottom: 16px;

.unified-api-loading-text {
  color: #6b7280;
  font-size: 14px;

  100% { transform: rotate(360deg); }

<span data-as="p">Large Language Models (LLMs) are types of AI model built using deep learning and natural language processing techniques. After being trained on massive amounts of text data, they can understand, generate, and process human language. LLMs have the following main capabilities:</span>
<ul>
<li>
<span data-as="p"><strong>Text Generation</strong></span>
<span data-as="p">LLMs can generate logically coherent content based on context and adjust output style as needed.</span>
</li>
<li>
<span data-as="p"><strong>Language Understanding</strong></span>
<span data-as="p">LLMs can accurately understand the meaning of input text and support context-aware conversation.</span>
</li>
<li>
<span data-as="p"><strong>Text Translation</strong></span>
<span data-as="p">LLMs are capable of cross-lingual understanding and generation, enabling translation between different languages.</span>
</li>
<li>
<span data-as="p"><strong>Knowledge-based Q&A</strong></span>
<span data-as="p">With extensive knowledge basis, LLMs can answer questions across domains such as culture, science, and history.</span>
</li>
<li>
<span data-as="p"><strong>Code Understanding & Generation</strong></span>
<span data-as="p">LLMs can understand and generate code (Python, Java, C++ and so on), detect code errors, and offer suggestions.</span>
</li>
<li>
<span data-as="p"><strong>Text Classification & Summarization</strong></span>
<span data-as="p">LLMs can understand complex sentences, categorize and extract information, and summarize key points.</span>
</li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">Novita AI provides fast, reliable APIs for open-source models, combining the ease and reliability of top-tier LLM APIs with the flexibility and cost-efficiency of open source LLMs.</span>
<ul>

<blockquote>
<span data-as="p">ChatCompletion Only</span>
</blockquote>
<span data-as="p"><code>messages</code>: Inputs and outputs when interacting with LLM. Each message belongs to one character. Messages can help you get better outputs, you can try different methods to get better results.</span>
<ul>
<li><code>content</code>: message content.</li>
<li><code>role</code>: Define the speaker:
<ul>
<li><code>system</code>: Set the AI’s role, telling model its role or behavior.</li>
<li><code>user</code>: The user’s input.</li>
<li><code>assistant</code>: The AI’s response. Users can give examples of output in advance, telling model how to answer current request.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><code>name</code> (optional): separating message writers with same role.</li>
</ul>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="prompt"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#prompt" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 18 18" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5" linecap="round" linejoin="round"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5" linecap="round" linejoin="round"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer">Prompt</span></h3>
<blockquote>
<span data-as="p">ChatCompletion Only</span>
</blockquote>
<span data-as="p"><code>prompt</code>: Instruction text for generating a completion written by user to LLM to tell the model their task clearly.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="output-control"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#output-control" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 18 18" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5" linecap="round" linejoin="round"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5" linecap="round" linejoin="round"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Output Control</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Different combination of parameters can help the model to generate more satisfying content.</span>
<span data-as="p"><strong>Diversity of Text</strong></span>
<blockquote>
<span data-as="p">‘temperature’ and ‘top_p’ can control the diversity of generated text, we advice you to set only one of them. The bigger the value you set, The more diverse the text will be.  The smaller the value you set, The more accurate the text will be.</span>
</blockquote>
<ul>
<li><code>temperature</code>: Controls randomness. Higher = more creative.</li>
<li><code>top_p</code>: Nucleus sampling. Controls cumulative probability.</li>
<li><code>top_k</code>: Limits candidate token count.</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p"><strong>Repetition Penalties</strong></span>
<ul>
<li><code>presence_penalty</code>: Controls repeated tokens of the texts. If one token has already existed in the text, penalty will come, this results in more token in the text.</li>
<li><code>frequency_penalty</code>: Control token frequency of the texts. Every time the same token exist in the text, penalty will come, which results in less same token in the future in the text.</li>
<li><code>repetition_penalty</code>: Penalizes or encourages repetition.</li>
</ul>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="output-limits"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#output-limits" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 18 18" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5" linecap="round" linejoin="round"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5" linecap="round" linejoin="round"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Output Limits</span></h3>
<ul>
<li><code>max_tokens</code>: Max tokens in one response. Content after this value in the text will be truncated.</li>
<li><code>stream</code>: Whether to use streaming. For those with long outputs, we advice you to use streaming mode to prevent timeout error:
<ul>
<li><code>true</code>: Streamed, partial results as they are generated.</li>
<li><code>false</code>: Full result after processing.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><code>stop</code>: Strings that will terminate generation when encountered.</li>
</ul></div><div class="pt-4 pb-16 text-sm text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">Last modified on<!-- --> <!-- -->August 4, 2026</div><nav id="pagination" aria-label="Pagination" class="px-0.5 flex import { chromium } from "playwright";
import TurndownService from "turndown";
import { gfm } from "@joplin/turndown-plugin-gfm";
import fs from "fs";
import path from "path";
import config from "./config.js";

function createTurndownService() {
  const td = new TurndownService({
    headingStyle: "atx",
    codeBlockStyle: "fenced",
    bulletListMarker: "-",
    hr: "---",
    emDelimiter: "*",
  });

  td.use(gfm);

  // Remove empty links and button-like anchors
  td.addRule("cleanLinks", {
    filter: (node) => {
      if (node.tagName !== "A") return false;
      const href = node.getAttribute("href") || "";
      return href === "#" || href === "" || href.startsWith("javascript:");
    },
    replacement: (content) => content,
  });

  // Keep meaningful link text, convert relative URLs to absolute
  td.addRule("simplifyLinks", {
    filter: "a",
    replacement: (content, node) => {
      const href = node.getAttribute("href") || "";
      const text = content.trim();
      if (!text) return "";
      if (href.startsWith("http")) {
        return `[${text}](${href})`;
      }
      if (href.startsWith("/")) {
        return `[${text}](${config.baseUrl}${href})`;
      }
      return text;
    },
  });

  return td;
}

async function autoScroll(page) {
  await page.evaluate(async () => {
    await new Promise((resolve) => {
      let totalHeight = 0;
      const distance = 500;
      const maxTime = 30000;
      const startTime = Date.now();
      const timer = setInterval(() => {
        const scrollHeight = document.body.scrollHeight;
        window.scrollBy(0, distance);
        totalHeight += distance;
        if (totalHeight >= scrollHeight || Date.now() - startTime > maxTime) {
          clearInterval(timer);
          window.scrollTo(0, 0);
          resolve();
        }
      }, 200);
    });
  });
}

async function revealAllTabPanels(page) {
  await page.evaluate(() => {
    document
      .querySelectorAll('[role="tabpanel"][data-state="inactive"]')
      .forEach((el) => {
        el.removeAttribute("hidden");
        el.style.display = "";
        el.setAttribute("data-state", "active");
      });
    document
      .querySelectorAll('[role="tabpanel"][hidden]')
      .forEach((el) => {
        el.removeAttribute("hidden");
        el.style.display = "";
      });
  });
}

async function extractTabsContent(page, tabConfig, excludeSelectors) {
  const { tabSelector, panelSelector, waitMs = 3000 } = tabConfig;
  const tabs = page.locator(tabSelector);
  const count = await tabs.count();

  if (count === 0) return "";

  let combinedHtml = "";
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const tabName = await tabs.nth(i).textContent();
    console.log(`     📑 Tab ${i + 1}/${count}: ${tabName.trim()}`);
    await tabs.nth(i).click();
    await page.waitForTimeout(waitMs);

    const panel = page.locator(panelSelector).first();
    const panelExists = (await panel.count()) > 0;
    if (!panelExists) continue;

    const panelHtml = await panel.evaluate(
      (el, { selectors, expandFnSource }) => {
        const clone = el.cloneNode(true);
        selectors.forEach((sel) => {
          clone.querySelectorAll(sel).forEach((child) => child.remove());
        });
        const expandMergedCells = new Function(
          "return " + expandFnSource
        )();
        expandMergedCells(clone);
        return clone.innerHTML;
      },
      {
        selectors: excludeSelectors,
        expandFnSource: expandMergedCellsSource().toString(),
      }
    );

    combinedHtml += `<h2>${tabName.trim()}</h2>\n${panelHtml}\n`;
  }

  return combinedHtml;
}

/**
 * Expand rowspan/colspan cells so every <tr> has a full set of <td>s.
 * Must run inside page.evaluate() context (operates on DOM nodes).
 */
function expandMergedCellsSource() {
  return function expandMergedCells(root) {
    root.querySelectorAll("table").forEach((table) => {
      const rows = Array.from(table.querySelectorAll("tr"));
      // pending[rowIndex] = [{ cell, colIndex }] — cells to insert from previous rowspans
      const pending = [];

      rows.forEach((row, ri) => {
        const cells = Array.from(row.children);
        let colIdx = 0;

        // First, insert any pending cells carried over from rowspans above
        if (pending[ri]) {
          for (const { cell, colIndex } of pending[ri]) {
            const clone = cell.cloneNode(true);
            clone.removeAttribute("rowspan");
            const ref = row.children[colIndex] || null;
            row.insertBefore(clone, ref);
          }
        }

        // Then scan for new rowspans in this row
        const updatedCells = Array.from(row.children);
        colIdx = 0;
        for (const cell of updatedCells) {
          const rs = parseInt(cell.getAttribute("rowspan") || "1", 10);
          if (rs > 1) {
            cell.removeAttribute("rowspan");
            for (let offset = 1; offset < rs; offset++) {
              const targetRow = ri + offset;
              if (!pending[targetRow]) pending[targetRow] = [];
              pending[targetRow].push({ cell, colIndex: colIdx });
            }
          }
          colIdx++;
        }
      });
    });
  };
}

async function extractPageHTML(page, excludeSelectors) {
  return await page.evaluate(
    ({ selectors, expandFnSource }) => {
      const clone = document.body.cloneNode(true);

      selectors.forEach((sel) => {
        clone.querySelectorAll(sel).forEach((el) => el.remove());
      });

      // Remove hidden elements
      clone
        .querySelectorAll('[style*="display: none"], [style*="display:none"]')
        .forEach((el) => el.remove());
      clone.querySelectorAll('[aria-hidden="true"]').forEach((el) => {
        if (!el.closest('[role="tabpanel"]')) {
          el.remove();
        }
      });

      // Expand rowspan cells so markdown tables are complete
      const expandMergedCells = new Function(
        "return " + expandFnSource
      )();
      expandMergedCells(clone);

      // Remove empty divs to reduce noise
      const removeEmptyNodes = (root) => {
        root.querySelectorAll("div, span, section").forEach((el) => {
          if (
            !el.textContent.trim() &&
            !el.querySelector("table, ul, ol")
          ) {
            el.remove();
          }
        });
      };
      removeEmptyNodes(clone);

      return clone.innerHTML;
    },
    {
      selectors: excludeSelectors,
      expandFnSource: expandMergedCellsSource().toString(),
    }
  );
}

function cleanMarkdown(md) {
  let result = md
    // Collapse 3+ newlines to 2
    .replace(/\n{3,}/g, "\n\n")
    // Remove lines that are only whitespace
    .replace(/^\s+$/gm, "")
    // Remove lines that are only special chars like | or -
    .replace(/^\s*[|\\-]{1,3}\s*$/gm, "")
    // Remove excessive dashes
    .replace(/^-{4,}$/gm, "---")
    // Clean up table formatting (remove empty rows)
    .replace(/\|\s*\|\s*\n/g, "")
    // Fix links that wrap entire blocks — convert [block content](url) to block + link
    .replace(/\[((#{1,6}\s+.+?\n[\s\S]*?))\]\(([^)]+)\)/g, (_, content, __, url) => {
      return `${content.trim()}\n\nLink: ${url}`;
    })
    .trim();

  // Remove duplicate consecutive lines (handles carousel duplicates)
  const lines = result.split("\n");
  const deduped = [lines[0]];
  for (let i = 1; i < lines.length; i++) {
    const current = lines[i].trim();
    const prev = lines[i - 1].trim();
    if (current === prev && current !== "" && current !== "---") continue;
    deduped.push(lines[i]);
  }

  // Remove captcha/verification noise that might slip through
  const filtered = deduped.filter((line) => {
    const trimmed = line.trim();
    // Only filter English verification/captcha noise lines
    return !(
      trimmed === "Security Verification" ||
      trimmed === "Refresh Captcha" ||
      trimmed === "Switch to Accessibility Verification" ||
      trimmed === "Switch to Standard Verification" ||
      trimmed === "Drag the puzzle piece below to complete verification" ||
      trimmed === "AI-generated background" ||
      trimmed.includes("Your speed has exceeded") ||
      trimmed === "Verification error, please retry"
    );
  });

  return filtered.join("\n").trim();
}

function buildMarkdownHeader(pageConfig, url) {
  const lines = [
    `# ${pageConfig.title}`,
    "",
    `> Page URL: ${url}`,
    `> Generated on: ${new Date().toLocaleString("en-US", { timeZone: "UTC" })}`,
  ];
  if (pageConfig.description) {
    lines.push(`> Description: ${pageConfig.description}`);
  }
  lines.push("", "---", "");
  return lines.join("\n");
}

async function generatePageMarkdown(browser, pageConfig, turndown) {
  const url = `${config.baseUrl}${pageConfig.route}`;
  const waitTime = pageConfig.waitAfterLoad || config.waitAfterLoad;

  console.log(`\n📄 Processing: ${pageConfig.title} (${url})`);

  const context = await browser.newContext({
    viewport: { width: 1920, height: 1080 },
    locale: "zh-CN",
    userAgent:

  });
  const page = await context.newPage();

  try {
    console.log("   ⏳ Loading page...");
    try {
      await page.goto(url, {
        waitUntil: "networkidle",
        timeout: config.timeout,
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (e.message.includes("Timeout")) {
        console.log(
          "   ⚠️  networkidle timeout, falling back to domcontentloaded..."
        );
        await page.goto(url, {
          waitUntil: "domcontentloaded",
          timeout: config.timeout,
        });
        await page.waitForTimeout(Math.max(waitTime, 10000));
      } else {
        throw e;
      }
    }
    await page.waitForTimeout(waitTime);

    console.log("   ⏳ Scrolling to load lazy content...");
    await autoScroll(page);
    await page.waitForTimeout(2000);

    // Execute per-page pre-extraction actions
    if (pageConfig.beforeExtract) {
      console.log("   ⏳ Running page-specific actions...");
      await pageConfig.beforeExtract(page);
      await page.waitForTimeout(2000);
    }

    let markdown;

    if (pageConfig.tabExtraction) {
      // Tab-based extraction: extract non-tab content + each tab separately
      console.log("   ⏳ Extracting tab content...");

      // First, extract non-tab static content by removing tablist + tabpanels from the page
      const staticHtml = await page.evaluate(
        (selectors) => {
          const clone = document.body.cloneNode(true);
          selectors.forEach((sel) => {
            clone.querySelectorAll(sel).forEach((el) => el.remove());
          });
          // Remove all tab-related elements from static extraction
          clone
            .querySelectorAll(
              '[role="tablist"], [role="tabpanel"], [role="tab"]'
            )
            .forEach((el) => el.remove());
          // Remove hidden elements
          clone
            .querySelectorAll(
              '[style*="display: none"], [style*="display:none"]'
            )
            .forEach((el) => el.remove());
          return clone.innerHTML;
        },
        config.excludeSelectors
      );

      // Then extract each tab's content
      const tabsHtml = await extractTabsContent(
        page,
        pageConfig.tabExtraction,
        config.excludeSelectors
      );

      const fullHtml = staticHtml + "\n" + tabsHtml;
      markdown = turndown.turndown(fullHtml);
      markdown = cleanMarkdown(markdown);
    } else {
      // Standard extraction: reveal hidden panels and extract everything
      await revealAllTabPanels(page);
      await page.waitForTimeout(500);

      console.log("   ⏳ Extracting content...");
      const html = await extractPageHTML(page, config.excludeSelectors);
      markdown = turndown.turndown(html);
      markdown = cleanMarkdown(markdown);
    }

    const header = buildMarkdownHeader(pageConfig, url);
    return header + markdown;
  } finally {
    await context.close();
  }
}

function parseArgs() {

    switch (args[i]) {

`);

}

  try {
    const results = [];

    for (const pageConfig of selectedPages) {
      try {
        const markdown = await generatePageMarkdown(
          browser,
          pageConfig,
          turndown
        );
        const outputPath = path.join(config.outputDir, pageConfig.filename);
        fs.writeFileSync(outputPath, markdown, "utf-8");

        const lineCount = markdown.split("\n").length;
        const charCount = markdown.length;
        console.log(
          `   ✅ ${pageConfig.filename} (${lineCount} lines, ${charCount} chars)`
        );
        results.push({
          page: pageConfig.route,
          file: pageConfig.filename,
          success: true,
        });
      } catch (err) {
        console.error(`   ❌ ${pageConfig.filename}: ${err.message}`);
        results.push({
          page: pageConfig.route,
          file: pageConfig.filename,
          success: false,
          error: err.message,
        });
      }
    }

    console.log("\n📊 Summary:");
    const succeeded = results.filter((r) => r.success).length;
    const failed = results.filter((r) => !r.success).length;
    console.log(
      `   ${succeeded} succeeded, ${failed} failed, ${results.length} total`
    );

    if (failed > 0) {
      console.log("   Failed pages:");
      results
        .filter((r) => !r.success)
        .forEach((r) => console.log(`     - ${r.page}: ${r.error}`));
      process.exit(1);
    }

    console.log(`\n🎉 All done! Files written to ${config.outputDir}/`);
  } finally {
    await browser.close();
  }
}

main().catch((err) => {
  console.error("❌ Fatal error:", err);
  process.exit(1);
});
